topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I knew it all along, the scent of deceit lingering heavier than the rest. When the brush moved, revealing the truth, it was as expected as the dawn. Others may have their vision clouded, but not I. I saw the path they took, the one that twisted away from the light and into shadows. They sought to impress with tales as hollow as a dried-up creek. Yet, it's not their loss that fills the air; it's the clarity that comes when the fog lifts, and the true landscape reveals itself. I carried no burden of surprise, only the steady gaze of one who watches, who knows.
